ticket.title: Provider returns intermittent 500 empty response and sawhorse blames max_tokens
ticket.description:
RESOLVED. The gateway non-streaming response assembly returns 500 "empty response content" for request bodies that stream correctly.

PROOF: the captured body /tmp/gbdump/universal-1793363254390.json returns 500 with `stream: false` and 200 with streamed content for `stream: true` - same bytes, same model, back to back.

FIX: sawhorse complete() retries a 500 whose body says `empty response content` once through the streaming path and re-assembles the text (7ffb3dc). Verified end to end: joiner fill --verify-crate now logs "recovered empty non-streamed content by streaming", returns tier gold with attempts 2, and writes the first Gold record to .gaugeblock/spool/outbox.jsonl (outbox 26, gold 1, typecheck_passed true, rejected_attempt carrying real code).

SIX HYPOTHESES WERE REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT FIRST, and each had cost real work before this: max_tokens 4096 vs 32768 fail identically; reasoning_effort none/low/medium/high/max all answer 200 on a plain prompt; dropping each of the three reasoning keys (reasoning{effort}, reasoning_effort, thinking{type:enabled}) still fails; thinking enabled or absent makes no difference; the temperature float32 artifact (0.20000000298023224) is irrelevant; structured output answers 200. Every individual piece of the failing user message answers 200 and only the combination fails - which is consistent with response-side assembly, not request content.

INSTRUMENT ADDED FOR THIS: SAWHORSE_DUMP_REQUEST=<file|dir> captures outbound bodies (9e26139), which is what made the reproduction possible after six failed guesses from the outside.
acceptance_criteria: A captured body reproduces the 500 and the same body passes after the fix
The trigger is named and the fix is verified on a live Gold fill
joiner fill --verify-crate returns tier gold end to end

verification_receipt.summary: Root cause: the gateway non-streaming path returns 500 empty response content for bodies that stream fine - the captured body gives 500 with stream:false and 200 with stream:true. Fixed in sawhorse complete() by retrying such a 500 once through the streaming path (7ffb3dc). Verified end to end: joiner fill --verify-crate reports tier gold, attempts 2, and writes the first Gold record to the spool (outbox 26, gold 1, typecheck_passed true). Six alternative hypotheses were refuted by measurement before this (max_tokens 4096 vs 32768, all reasoning efforts, each reasoning key dropped, thinking on/off, temperature artifact, structured output), and SAWHORSE_DUMP_REQUEST was added so bodies can be reproduced instead of guessed at.

task.title: Provider returns intermittent 500 empty response and sawhorse blames max_tokens
task.description: Measured, five calls each, same model and key: a structured joiner-style prompt (system message, file context, fenced code) failed 3 of 5 with HTTP 500 empty response content, while a short plain prompt failed 0 of 5. So the failure is intermittent and prompt-shape related, not a token budget problem - but sawhorse appends a diagnostic that asserts reasoning models exhausted max_tokens, which is a guess presented as a cause. That guess cost two wrong fixes before it was tested: GB-206 raised the budget 1024 to 8192, and GB-212 disabled the reasoning trace; neither addressed the flake, though both are defensible on their own terms. Two changes are needed: a bounded retry in the router for an empty-content 500 (transient), and a diagnostic that states what was observed and ranks likely causes instead of naming one. A single-sample bisect of this cost me a wrong conclusion about code fences, which is worth remembering as a measurement discipline point.

events.description:
Provider returns a 500 "empty response content" for some prompts, and sawhorse used to blame max_tokens.

REPRODUCED (deterministic). `SAWHORSE_DUMP_REQUEST=/tmp/gbdump joiner fill /tmp/gb-gold-crate/src/lib.rs --symbol grapheme_count --max-tokens 4096` captures a 753-byte body that fails 5/5 on replay via curl. That capture is now the fixture for all further bisection.

REFUTED, each by measurement on the same model (cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017):
- max_tokens exhaustion: 4096 and 32768 fail identically; the prompt is ~260 tokens against a 1M window.
- reasoning trace eating the budget: reasoning_effort=none with max_tokens=4096 still fails.
- the triple reasoning encoding (reasoning{effort} + reasoning_effort + thinking{type:enabled}): dropping each key individually still fails.
- temperature float32 artifact (0.20000000298023224): fails identically at 0.2.
- structured output: json_object and json_schema answer 200.
- all six reasoning effort values: 200 with a plain prompt.
- fenced-only response being eaten by an artifact extractor: asking for a pure fence answers 200 twice.
- prompt length: every individual piece of the failing user message answers 200 (intent / fenced current code / diagnostics / fence request).

CONFIRMED: only the COMBINATION of those pieces fails. Same model, same system message, pieces alone 200, together 500. Splitting into separate user turns still fails.

NEXT: bisect the response side. "empty response content" is a content-extraction error, and stream:true takes a different code path through the gateway, so replay the captured body with streaming before touching prompt wording. Then binary-search which two pieces interact.

Cost of the previous misdiagnosis: GB-206/GB-212 raised the budget twice and disabled reasoning on the strength of a message that asserted a cause it had not measured. The diagnostic now reports the observation and ranks causes (GB-215).
acceptance_criteria: A captured body from /tmp/gbdump reproduces the 500 and the same body passes after the fix
The trigger is named as a specific pair of prompt elements, or the streaming path is proven to bypass it
